additionalTargets.description: List of additional targets that should be run

buildTarget.description: The target used to build the library with the ng-packagr

ngVersionPlaceholder.description: The placeholder string that gets replaced by the corresponding angular versions for the package in your package.json

versionPlaceholder.description: The placeholder string that gets replaced by the corresponding version in your package.json

description:
The project is configured to use **packagr** as its primary build target for the ng‑packagr library packaging process. In addition to the main build, the workflow will also execute the **test** and **lint** targets to ensure code quality and correctness before publishing.

When the package metadata is generated, the placeholders **{{NG_VERSION}}** and **{{VERSION}}** will be substituted with the appropriate Angular version and the library’s version from the package.json, respectively. This ensures that the final distributed package reflects the correct versioning information.
